item.title: Brain biology contributes to weight regain after dieting
item.description:
The human brain is biologically programmed to protect body fat, often treating previous weight as the new normal. This mechanism triggers increased hunger and lower energy expenditure, explaining why many struggle to maintain weight loss without intervention.
